items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: His name was Duke Brooks. And he recorded with me later.

ctx.x: Like Neal Hefti, Johnny Mandel... I could go on and name a whole lot of guys who used to be around. Art Pepper. So many guys used to be around on the scene. Russ Freeman used to be through there. Shelly Manne. Different guys would be down there. We'd all be getting together ganging up on the music, you know.

I'd like to mention a piano player who was a terrific guy and a fantastic piano player. His name was Duke Brooks. And he recorded with me later. I'll get into that later, but I wanted to make sure I mentioned his name.
